title: Task 3: Strong password
problem_statement:
Task: Complete is_strong_password: 12+ characters, no username (any case), at least 3 of 4 groups (lower, upper, digit, symbol).

Steps

  1. Write your plan on paper.
  2. Accept the suggestion. Run pytest test_password.py.
  3. Steer the tool until all tests pass.

python.content:
import pytest

from password import is_strong_password


@pytest.mark.parametrize("password, username, expected", [
    ("Sunny-Day-2026", "maria", True),
    ("Sunny-day-rocks2026", "maria", True),
    ("sunnydayrocks2026", "maria", False),
    ("SUNNYDAYROCKS!!", "maria", False),
    ("Ab1!Ab1!Ab1", "x", False),
    ("Maria-2026-Rocks!", "maria", False),
    ("", "maria", False),
])
def test_is_strong_password(password, username, expected):
    assert is_strong_password(password, username) == expected
